name: Snac Lite! Soya Katori Masala Dhamaka
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein Oil, Cotton Seed, Rice Bran), Tapioca Starch, Corn Starch, Defatted Soy Flour (12%), Spices & Condiments [Cumin Powder, Red Chilli Powder (0.5%), Coriander Powder (0.4%), Clove Powder (0.10%), Black Pepper Powder (0.05%), Big Cardamom Powder, Amchur Powder, Spices Extract], Tomato Powder (0.30%), Iodised Salt, Sugar Powder, Black Salt Powder, Acidity Regulator (INS330), Anticaking Agent (INS551), Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances.
